metadata.remarks:
Identity Logging and Audit defines the capability to generate, protect, retain, and analyze records of identity-related actions. Logging applies across authentication, authorization, lifecycle, assurance, and federation to support accountability, investigation, compliance, and non-repudiation.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, and assurance related to identity logging and audit. Identity semantics are defined by Identity Core; logging provides evidentiary assurance.
